(a) Each stabilizing and control surface must be designed so that--
  (1) Limit loads are not less than the greater of--
    (i) 15 pounds per square foot; or
    (ii) The load resulting where C_{N} equals 0.55 at the maximum design speed; and
  (2) The surface can withstand the critical loads resulting from maneuvers and from combined maneuvers and gusts.
(b) Compliance with paragraph (a) of this section must be shown with load distributions that closely simulate actual pressure distribution conditions.
